messages:
alex: Heads-up — ACME (customer_acme) flagged invoice PDF: missing remittance/bank reference, PO not appearing on header, and when multiple legal entities are present the address block shows combined lines and misses VAT placement. They're blocked on payment. Attaching sample. maria_finance: Can you drop the exact invoice id? We need invoice id + sample PDF. Without PO in header their AP won't process. sam_support: Invoice INV-2026 attached by customer in support ticket #7429. Repro steps: upload PDF -> AP system parses header -> PO empty -> decline. Also card decline? No, this is PO workflow. billing-bot: Auto-check: invoice INV-2026 flagged: missing field remittance_reference -> severity: high. Suggested tag: billing-escalation. jinja_engineering: @maria_finance we use template v2.1 for legal block. If customer has multiple entities we currently render them as newline-separated freeform. We should add "Legal entity (billing):" header and VAT/Tax ID on the same line as the entity name. Proposed template diff: ```html
{{entity.name}} {{entity.suffix}}
{{entity.vat_id}}
{{entity.address.line1}}
``` maria_finance: Also need "PO number" to render in top-right under Invoice #. Current PDF places it in footer if present. AP teams require PO in header. Can we make position configurable per customer? Need an opt-in per billing profile. olga_ops: For urgency — customer says "payment hold until CSV parser accepts invoice". Prioritize patch to template rendering and re-run generation for INV-2026. Also include bank remittance details line: "BankRef: ". sam_support: Repro steps I sent earlier — for internal testing use this cURL to fetch invoice JSON: ```bash curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\ https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026.json ``` Payload snippet: ```json {"invoice_number":"INV-2026","po_number":null,"billing_entity":{"name":"Redwood Inference","vat_id":"GB999999999","address":["1 Redwood Way","SF CA 94107"]},"remittance_reference":null} ``` jinja_engineering: We'll add a rendering rule: if billing_profile.requires_po_header true then show PO in header; also add remittance_reference if present; default to "BankRef: --" if null. Timeline: patch tomorrow, QA same day, regen PDF once merged. maria_finance: Confirm: will this be a per-customer flag, or global change? Customer's AP team won't accept footer-only PO; need header. jinja_engineering: Per-customer flag — will add billing_profile flag and a one-off migration to re-generate pending invoices for customers with open payment holds. We'll need finance to give list. maria_finance: I'll export list of affected invoices and customers by EOD and attach. Thanks. :pray: customer_acme: Thanks team — AP says if PO appears in header and bank ref included they can push payment. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
